result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by construction activity that has completely blocked the sidewalk. Pedestrians are forced into the roadway without a protected temporary walkway or clear detour signage.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Construction fencing and dumpsters completely block the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the building frontage

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Walkway
hazards.description: No temporary protected path is provided for pedestrians forced into the roadway by the construction site.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway adjacent to the construction fence

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Establish a protected temporary walkway in the roadway using water-filled barriers to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Wayfinding Signage
interventions.description: Install clear signage directing pedestrians to the other side of the street or to a safe detour route.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by construction activity that completely blocks the sidewalk with fencing and a dumpster. No temporary protected walkway is provided, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway alongside vehicular traffic without physical separation.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Construction fencing and a large dumpster completely block the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center foreground along the building frontage.

hazards.name: Lack of Temporary Pedestrian Path
hazards.description: No safe, separated walkway is provided for pedestrians to bypass the construction zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area adjacent to the construction fence.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Establish a temporary, ADA-compliant pedestrian path in the roadway using water-filled barriers to separate people from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Detour Signage
interventions.description: Install clear signage at the nearest intersections to inform pedestrians of the closure and direct them to a safe alternative route.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with continuous sidewalks but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the intersection. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices visible, and parked vehicles significantly obstruct sightlines for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space or priority for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection block visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking at the intersection corners

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps creates a physical barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions or parking restrictions near the corner to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection lacking basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. Parked vehicles along the curb create visual obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the unmarked roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The lack of painted crosswalks makes pedestrians less visible and predictable to drivers at this intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where the pedestrian is crossing

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the corner block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: Vertical curbs at the crossing point create physical barriers for people with limited mobility or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all intersection corners.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.
